title: Perception Autonomy Engineer
description:
**Career Area:**

Technology, Digital and Data

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition

Caterpillar’s Cat Technology team is seeking a Perception Developer to design, develop, and deploy perception software for autonomous and semi-autonomous machines used in construction. The role focuses on multi-sensor perception, computer vision, 3D point-cloud processing, sensor fusion, and production-quality software for safety-critical, resource-constrained platforms. The ideal candidate combines strong C++/Python development skills with hands-on experience building, optimizing, and validating perception algorithms from prototype through field deployment.

Responsibilities:

1. Design and implement perception algorithms for object and personnel detection, classification, segmentation, tracking, terrain understanding, localization, mapping, and obstacle assessment.

2. Develop camera, LiDAR, radar, GNSS, and IMU processing pipelines, including calibration, synchronization, sensor fusion, and uncertainty handling.

3. Translate research concepts and state-of-the-art models into robust, maintainable, production-quality C++ and Python software.

4. Optimize algorithms and neural-network inference for embedded CPU/GPU platforms using profiling, CUDA, TensorRT, and related acceleration technologies.

5. Build automated evaluation workflows, datasets, simulation scenarios, and test tools to measure accuracy, latency, robustness, and safety performance.

6. Debug and resolve perception issues using recorded data, simulation, hardware-in-the-loop systems, and field-machine testing.

7. Collaborate with systems, autonomy, controls, embedded software, validation, and safety teams to define interfaces and deliver integrated machine capabilities.

8. Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, technical documentation, and continuous improvement of software engineering practices.

Desired Qualifications:

1. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.

2. Strong programming skills in modern C++ and Python, with experience developing and debugging software on Linux.

3. Practical experience with computer vision, deep learning, 3D geometry, point-cloud processing, or robotic perception.

4. Experience with one or more perception tasks such as detection, segmentation, classification, tracking, localization, mapping, or sensor fusion.

5. Working knowledge of PyTorch or TensorFlow and common perception libraries such as OpenCV, PCL, Eigen, or similar tools.

6. Understanding of camera, LiDAR, radar, GNSS, and IMU sensor characteristics, calibration, coordinate systems, and data quality considerations.

7. Experience with ROS/ROS 2, DDS, Git, unit testing, continuous integration, and software documentation practices.

8. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills, with the ability to work across research and product-development teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

1. Experience deploying perception models on embedded or edge platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson, DRIVE, or comparable hardware.

2. Experience with CUDA, TensorRT, model quantization, profiling, and real-time performance optimization.

3. Knowledge of SLAM, visual or LiDAR odometry, Kalman filtering, probabilistic estimation, and graph-based spatial data structures.

4. Experience developing perception systems for autonomous vehicles, ADAS, mobile robots, mining, construction, or off-highway equipment.

5. Experience with simulation, synthetic data, dataset curation, annotation workflows, MLOps, or field validation.

6. Publications, patents, or demonstrated implementation of state-of-the-art perception methods are an advantage.

Be Part of What’s Next in Autonomous Construction Sites

Construction autonomy is one of the most complex challenges in applied AI, and at Caterpillar, advancements in physical AI, simulation, sensing, and edge computing are turning things that once felt impossible—intelligent machines operating in dynamic jobsites—into reality.

Our connected ecosystem brings together massive volumes [BH1.1][LR1.2]of high-quality data to create a foundation where engineers like you can build and deploy against.

If this work motivates you, we invite you to join our team. In these roles, you’ll work at the intersection of the physical and digital worlds. You’ll help design and deliver intelligent systems that enable machines to perceive their environment, make informed decisions, and support safer, more productive operations.

Apply today to build the new era of construction autonomy at Caterpillar.

title: Lead - Network & Design Engineer (DNS, BIND, Route53)
description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
  
  
We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience.
**Want to be part of it?**
**About The Role**
We are seeking a highly skilled Network & DNS Design Engineer to join our Network Engineering team. This role is responsible for the design, governance, automation and L3 support of enterprise DNS, domain management and core network services across cloud, datacentre and corporate environments.
  
  
The successful candidate will be a subject matter expert in DNS technologies including AWS Route53, Microsoft Active Directory-integrated DNS and BIND, with responsibility for ensuring the availability, security and scalability of critical name resolution services supporting both internal users and customer-facing platforms.
  
  
The role requires a strong engineering mindset, a passion for automation, and practical experience applying AI-driven solutions to improve operational efficiency, governance and service reliability.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement and manage enterprise DNS services across AWS Route53, Microsoft DNS and BIND platforms.
* Own the design and governance of public and private DNS infrastructure, including hosted zones, delegation, forwarding, conditional forwarding and resolver services.
* Manage the organisation's domain portfolio, including registrations, renewals, transfers, security controls and lifecycle governance.
* Design and support DNS services integrated with Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS), ensuring reliable operation of authentication, Group Policy and Windows-based services.
* Act as the L3 escalation point for complex DNS, domain and network-related incidents.
* Develop and maintain DNS, domain and network standards, documentation and operational processes.
* Design and implement automation solutions using APIs, scripting and Infrastructure as Code.
* Leverage AI-assisted tooling to improve DNS management, domain governance, change validation, troubleshooting and operational reporting.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, security and application teams to deliver resilient and secure services.
* Contribute to the design and support of routing, switching, firewalls, load balancing and hybrid-cloud networking solutions.

**Essential skills & experience:**

* Extensive experience with AWS Route53, including public and private hosted zones, delegation and DNS governance.
* Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft DNS running on Active Directory Domain Controllers.
* Strong experience with BIND DNS administration and architecture.
* Deep understanding of DNS protocols, DNSSEC, recursive and authoritative DNS services.
* Experience managing enterprise domain portfolios and registrar relationships.
* Strong knowledge of TCP/IP networking, routing, switching and network security principles.
* Experience with DNS/IPAM integration and tooling.
* Experience with automation technologies such as Python, PowerShell, Terraform or similar.
* Experience using APIs and Infrastructure as Code to automate operational processes.
* Experience applying AI technologies to infrastructure management, operational efficiency or service automation.

**Desirable experience:**

* AWS networking and infrastructure services.
* F5 DNS/GTM and load balancing technologies.
* NetBox, SolarWinds, Infoblox or similar IPAM platforms.
* VPN, firewall and cloud networking technologies.
* GitOps and modern infrastructure automation practices.
* Experience supporting large-scale global enterprise environments.

**Key Attributes**

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Automation-first mindset.
* Excellent documentation and governance discipline.
* Ability to lead technical standards and best practices.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Passion for innovation and the practical application of AI within infrastructure operations.

**Why join us?**
We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space - and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.
  
  
**An inclusive environment to thrive**
We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles - not just on key days, but every day.
  
  
**Be rewarded for your efforts**
We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.

description:

ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world's leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

### **Reports To**

Senior Manager - AI & IT

### **What You Will Be Doing**

ChargePoint is looking for a IAM Engineer to lead enterprise identity strategy and platform architecture across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments. This role owns cloud identity, directory services, Okta identity workflows, and the transition of applications to modern authentication standards (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML). You will define and implement reference architectures for secure authentication across CLI, browser, and agentic workflows.  
You will establish agent identities as a foundational element within the identity platform, enabling access control and auditability for automated and machine-assisted workflows. You will build and implement Conditional Access policies, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), risk-based authentication, and Okta Identity Governance (OIG) programs. You will also scale device management and identity governance systems to meet the demands of AI-powered operations while maintaining reliability, performance, and compliance across large organizational environments.  
This is a hands-on technical role. You will code, design, and implement IAM solutions with deep knowledge in AWS, Azure, Teleport, and Terraform. You will partner with security, infrastructure, and product teams to align on architecture, build strategy, and operational ownership.  
  
**What You Will Bring to ChargePoint**

* Lead enterprise identity strategy and platform architecture, encompassing cloud identity, directory services, and the transition of applications to modern authentication standards (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML).
* Define and implement reference architectures for secure authentication across CLI, browser, and agentic workflows.
* Establish agent identities as a foundational element within the identity platform, enabling access control and auditability for automated and machine-assisted workflows.
* Build and implement advanced identity security controls such as Conditional Access policies, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and risk-based authentication.
* Scale device management and identity governance systems to meet the demands of AI-powered operations. Ensure reliability, performance, and compliance across large organizational environments.
* Partner with security, infrastructure, and product teams to align on architecture, build strategy, and operational ownership.
* Drive IAM application development: code, design, and implement solutions with deep knowledge in AWS, Azure, Teleport, and Terraform. Deliver reliable solutions that keep engineering teams productive.
* Drive IAM projects end-to-end: take ambiguous access problems, define requirements, architect solutions, and own the rollout and operationalization — not just the design.
* Refine role design and access patterns across AWS, Kubernetes, SaaS, and internal systems — eliminate unnecessary privileges, reduce manual grants, and establish scalable baseline access.
* Run and improve user access reviews (UAR): develop, execute, and design a UAR process and solution that meets compliance requirements while improving real security signal — minimize approver burden through scoping, automation, and clear decision support.
* Identify high-risk permissions and misuse paths, build controls and mitigations, and drive adoption with partner teams to reduce risk exposure.
* Operate with strong security judgment and high signal: distinguish meaningful IAM risk from noise, gather context efficiently, and escalate with crisp rationale and actionable mitigations.
* Document and standardize the paved road: write procedures, runbooks, and automation so access decisions are consistent, scalable, and not dependent on tribal knowledge.
* Conduct Agentic AI IAM requirement analyses, architecture reviews, and security gap assessments across enterprise applications, cloud platforms, AI services, and infrastructure environments.
* Develop automation for access management and secrets lifecycle operations.
* Develop and implement security controls for AI agents, machine identities, APIs, workloads, and autonomous workflows.
* Lead enterprise Agentic AI IAM program execution across multiple workstreams.
* Establish security controls for AI agents, autonomous workflows, bots, and machine identities.
* Standardize identity governance across multi-cloud ecosystems.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* 8-12 years of experience in IAM, cloud security, or cybersecurity engineering.
* Strong experience in Agentic AI IAM architecture, identity governance, secrets management, security engineering, and enterprise IAM program delivery.
* Strong expertise in requirement gathering, current-state assessments, gap analyses, control evaluations, and target-state Agentic AI IAM security architecture design.
* Experience securing cloud-native and hybrid environments and managing hybrid cloud IAM and secrets management programs.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust architecture and machine identity security.
* Experience implementing AI/Agentic security controls and secure automation frameworks.
* Platform experience: Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Google Cloud Secrets Manager, AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, container security platforms.
* Experience with Terraform, CI/CD, and DevSecOps tooling.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or CCSP. (good to have)

title: Embedded Software Technical Lead
description:
At **Kandou**, we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to **democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)** of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption.

Our proprietary **MIMO-over-copper technology** powers a **high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric** that is both **scalable and energy-efficient**. Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution **reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly** while preserving **high bandwidth and ultra-low latency** — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale.

As **Embedded Software Technical Lead**, you will lead the implementation and delivery of assigned firmware modules and workstreams for Kandou's new ASIC products, under the technical direction of the overall Firmware Lead. You will remain hands-on in coding, debugging and bring-up, while mentoring engineers working on your scope. The overall Firmware Lead owns the firmware roadmap, team-wide priorities and release decisions; this role owns execution within the agreed architecture and project plan.

**Responsabilities**

* Lead the design, development, test and maintenance of assigned real-time firmware modules for high-speed heterogeneous SoC platforms.
* Translate agreed system requirements into module designs and hardware/software interfaces; review architecture and interface changes with the Firmware Lead and architects.
* Plan and coordinate assigned work: estimate effort, track dependencies and milestones, and escalate risks and priority conflicts to the Firmware Lead.
* Remain hands-on in C/C++ development, RTOS integration, low-level drivers, bootloaders, secure boot and reliable firmware updates.
* Drive bring-up, hardware/software integration and root-cause analysis for assigned firmware, working with silicon design and validation teams.
* Lead module-level design and code reviews, apply team coding and test standards, and provide validation evidence and documentation for firmware release reviews.
* Mentor engineers on assigned work, guide implementation decisions and share knowledge; align broader technical decisions with the Firmware Lead.

Coordinate with validation and applications teams to resolve integration and field issues; improve the software tools supporting silicon development and debug.

**Essential Experience**

* 10+ years of experience designing, coding and debugging real-time embedded applications in C and/or C++, including 2+ years providing technical leadership for firmware modules or projects.
* Demonstrated ownership of firmware module delivery from requirements and design through bring-up, validation and release integration within a wider engineering team.
* Strong embedded SoC experience with bare-metal and RTOS environments, including RTOS porting and integration with Zephyr, FreeRTOS or equivalent.
* Knowledge of RISC-V architecture and hands-on bare-metal or RTOS firmware development for RV32/RV64 cores, including trap handling, CSR access and toolchain setup.
* Board and SoC bring-up using JTAG and other debug mechanisms; ability to diagnose complex issues across firmware, drivers and hardware.
* Experience interfacing with hardware and peripherals using SPI, I2C/SMBus, I3C and JTAG, and implementing bootloaders, secure boot and firmware update flows.
* Proficiency in Python or another modern scripting language, and practical use of Git/GitLab, CI, Make/CMake and automated unit and integration testing.
* Strong design-review, documentation, organisational, presentation and mentoring skills; ability to align cross-functional teams and learn new technical areas.

**Useful Experience**

* Heterogeneous multicore systems with scalar and vector processors; embedded Linux, memory and network interfaces, and virtual memory.
* High-speed signalling technologies such as PCIe and CXL, including link training, equalization and retimer/redriver interaction with host and device PHYs.
* Firmware for Active Electrical Cable (AEC) or retimer/redriver ASICs, including cable diagnostics, eye margin monitoring, temperature/voltage telemetry and power-state management.
* Management and sideband protocols including SMBus, I3C, MCTP and CMIS; SerDes technology and PHY register-level tuning.
* Simulation, co-simulation and FPGA platforms for pre-silicon firmware development; HyperBus and HyperRAM technologies.

Cryptographic algorithms and secure firmware lifecycle practices, including authenticated updates, recovery and rollback protection.
